properties.displayName: UAV S104 - Unauthorized Scatter/Break-Formation Command Injection
properties.description: UAVSwarmComms_CL의 scatter_cmd 메시지에서 Authorized=false이거나 ScatterCommandIssuedBy가 Approved_Operators_List에 비등록인 대형 분산/이탈 명령주입(scatter) 탐지. MITRE: T0855 Unauthorized Command Message (ICS 근사매핑 — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let scatterDivergingRatio = 0.7;
UAVFleetState_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ActiveUAVCount > 0
| extend DivergingRatio = todouble(DivergingCount) / todouble(ActiveUAVCount)
| where DivergingRatio >= scatterDivergingRatio and CommonCommand == "scatter"
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("대형분산이탈명령주입의심_이탈비율_", tostring(round(DivergingRatio*100,1)), "%_명령_", CommonCommand)
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, FleetId, WindowStart, ActiveUAVCount, DivergingCount, DivergingRatio, CommonCommand, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S104 - Unauthorized Scatter/Break-Formation Command Injection - {{FleetId}}
